This ordering is critical for correct alpha blending in volume rendering and for maintaining visibility order in rasterization-based approaches.

It differs from [Point Location](2076-point-location.md) by focusing on traversal order rather than spatial indexing, and from [Fast Projection for Octree Nodes](2178-fast-projection-for-octree-nodes.md) by explicitly handling the depth-sorting logic required for correct compositing.
